The DJ [[Rangthang/Legends|Rangthang]] was a member of a '''species''' that was [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] race with 4 [[Limb/Legends|arms]] and 4 legs. The [[Species/Legends|species]] also had tentacles on their faces.
